calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Technical same-canvas SEGMENTATION, not a new illustration or portrait.
Output an OPAQUE black-and-white matte at exactly 1536 x 1024 with no transparency.
The ONLY input image is the complete primary-approved Uika chat mother. Do not redesign the girl, change her pose or repaint a person. Recolor the pixels of the EXISTING visible person IN PLACE: every visible pixel of Uika becomes solid pure WHITE, every pixel of the ROOM becomes pure BLACK. Only the actual outer/inner silhouette edges may have narrow antialiasing.

EXACT REGISTRATION: preserve the full canvas, camera and source coordinate system. The person is small at the RIGHT of a wide room. Keep the head around x=1240..1370,y=258..390; torso around x=1235..1390,y=370..555; long skirt around x=1120..1380,y=520..735; shoes around x=1090..1220,y=705..770; supporting hand around x=1370..1425,y=565..590. These are only location guides; TRACE THE ACTUAL INPUT CONTOUR, not rectangles or a different silhouette. Do not zoom/crop/enlarge/recenter the girl or move the head/feet. Most of the canvas stays pure black, including every canvas corner.

INCLUDE ONLY the original existing girl's complete hair tips, face, neck, T-shirt, bare arms and every finger, long skirt hem, two calves/ankles, socks and both complete WORN black-and-white sneakers. All these body/clothing surfaces become solid white even if their original RGB is dark or contains folds. There is NO book, paper or held prop in this mother.
EXCLUDE the cushion, pillows, bench, its wood, every room object, desk/lamp/cup/chair, window/curtains/lake, plants, rug/floor and ALL cast/contact shadows. The gaps between arm and torso, between legs/shoes and between fingers stay black wherever the input shows room. Do not paint pillow into the shoulder/hand silhouette or fill a room gap. Do not include floor patches under shoe soles.
No internal drawing, face lines, gray cloth folds, colored pixels, glow, blur, shadow, writing, arrows, labels, borders or watermark. This matte will carry the UNMODIFIED original mother RGB later; it must match its exact visible body silhouette and preserve every original contour, not invent anatomy or a hidden surface. Return the complete same-size black canvas with only that source-registered person white.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Technical same-canvas CLEAN BACKGROUND EXTRACTION, NOT a new room.
Input image 1 is the complete primary-approved Uika chat mother, 1536 x 1024. Remove ONLY the existing girl Uika, all her worn clothing/shoes and the narrow local cast/contact shadows made by her on the cushion/bench and floor. There is no book or held prop in this mother. Reconstruct the exact linen cushion, right pillows, bench wood and floor immediately behind the removed person as a plausible empty version of THIS SAME mother scene.

PRESERVE REGISTRATION: exact full 1536 x 1024 canvas, same camera, perspective and room scale. Keep the complete four-sided window frame, lake/campus/trees/sky, curtains, left table/chair/bookshelves/framed drawing, right desk/chair/lamp/cup/book, bench/pillows/throw, rug, floor lines, window sunlight and every visible piece of furniture unchanged. Do not move, straighten, resize or replace any furniture or change colors/light. Visible pixels outside the removed person's small right-hand footprint should remain their source positions. The cushion may relax where her hips were, but keep its existing seam, fabric, edge and perspective.
No human remnant, hair, hand, sock, sneaker, ghost silhouette, floating cloth, invented prop, UI, text, watermark, border or logo. No zoom, crop, white gradient, new empty wall or redesign. Background stays opaque. Return the whole exact-size EMPTY scene with only the local removal repaired.
